printRun.label: What one print run prints
printRun.help: Stickers only (as before), each parcel's sticker followed by its customer invoice, or the invoices only — always in packing order, as one PDF. An invoice in the run prints on paper or on the thermal roll, with the invoice's own paper and roll settings. Printing never books a parcel or changes a price, a charge or COD.

history.label: Handed-over history
history.help: How many days back the handover page lists the batches handed over to each courier, and at most how many per courier. Each one can print a copy of its sheet.
